messages:
ashwin: Noticed a recurring pattern of dropped spans and late ETL windows over the past 5 days. Peaks every ~8 hours, looks correlated with heavy shard compaction. Starting a focused follow-up thread to collect owners and next steps. cc @lina @kevin
lina: Can you share the basic metric and query you used?
ashwin: Quick check:```
-- hourly span ingestion delta
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) as hr, count(*) as spans_in
FROM spans_raw
WHERE received_at > now() - interval '5 days'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr DESC;
```
kevin: I see repeated troughs at 00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC. Those match nightly compaction windows for shard groups 10-14.
ops-bot: Alert triggered: "span_ingest_gap" (severity: p2) — incident created: INC-20461. Playbook: /playbooks/ingest-gaps.md
ashwin: Observed two failure modes in the worker logs: short OOM spikes and a backpressure fallback that drops partial batches. Paste:```
[2026-03-12T16:01:33Z] etl-worker[pid=2145]: warn: backpressure triggered, dropping partial batch shard=12 batch_id=4321
[2026-03-12T16:01:34Z] kubelet: OOMKilled container=etl-worker-xxxx
```
lina: Suggestion: short-term mitigations: 1) stageload compaction to off-peak nodes, 2) increase worker mem to 5Gi for heavy shards, 3) enable safer fallback that retries partial batches instead of dropping. Who can own each?
kevin: I can take compaction schedule changes and coord with infra (24h). ashwin can take memory + retry logic changes?
ashwin: I can do the ETL code changes (retry partial batches) and run a heap profile during the next window (48h). I'll open a PR and link it here.
product-analytics: We need to quantify customer-facing impact. Can someone add the query that maps missing spans to metrics (page load traces affected)? I can pull the dashboard after they run.
lina: I'll add a temporary dashboard tile showing span_in vs processed_traces and annotate the compaction windows. Draft PR: https://git.internal/infra/pull/215
kevin: Infra plan: anti-affinity + node taint during compaction windows to isolate heavy compaction. I'll file infra ticket and schedule 2h maintenance window for testing. Ticket: INF-1329.
nashwin: PR created: https://git.internal/etl/pull/789 — implements retry for partial batches + heap profiler flag. Marking as WIP.
nashwin: Proposed action item list (adding to INC-20461 tracker):
- ashwin: implement retry + heap profiling, attach heap dump from next window, propose patch (due +48h)
- kevin: compaction schedule changes + infra anti-affinity, test maintenance window (due +24h)
- lina: temporary dashboard + alert tuning (reduce false positives) (due +12h)
- product-analytics: impact mapping + affected customer list (due +72h)
lina: I'll also add a 2-week recurrence watch in the monitoring config and a weekly check-in calendar for the owners.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20461 updated: owners set [ashwin, kevin, lina], priority P2. Next review 2026-03-13T09:00:00Z UTC.
kevin: Quick note: I ran a local compaction simulation and saw memory spike on shard 13; increasing buffers reduced transient OOMs. Will validate on staging.
ashwin: If staging looks good, I'll roll the retry patch behind a feature flag and canary to a single heavy shard.
product-analytics: Once we have canary results, I'll recompute trace coverage and send a short note to affected customers if their SLO is impacted.
lina: TL;DR: owners assigned, infra + code + observability actions agreed, tracker updated. Please drop :white_check_mark: when you start each item.
ashwin: :white_check_mark: starting heap profiling and PR review.
kevin: :white_check_mark: infra ticket filed and scheduling maintenance.
product-analytics: :white_check_mark: starting impact analysis.
nashwin: I'll attach logs, heap dumps, and canary link to INC-20461 once available. Closing this triage thread; will reopen if we see recurrence after mitigation.
